index.description.001: I-E-Ink Assistant ilungisa ukugqama, imininingwane yezithunzi nombala ezibonisini ze-e-ink ku-macOS ne-Windows.
index.text.013: Lungisa ukugqama kombhalo, imininingwane yezithunzi nombala ezibonisini ze-e-ink ozikhethayo. Ezinye izibonisi zakho azishintshwa.
index.text.022: UKUGQAMA KOMBHALO ✦ IMINININGWANE YEZITHUNZI ✦ UKUGCWALA KOMBALA + RGB ✦ OKUSETHIWE KWESIBONISI NGASINYE ✦ UKUGQAMA KOMBHALO ✦ IMINININGWANE YEZITHUNZI ✦ UKUGCWALA KOMBALA + RGB ✦ OKUSETHIWE KWESIBONISI NGASINYE ✦
index.text.025: Ukugqama Kombhalo kwenza amakhasi okufunda abe mnyama. Ukuthuthukisa Ividiyo kuveza imininingwane yezithombe ezimnyama. Ukugcwala Kombala ne-RGB kusiza amaphaneli e-e-ink anemibala.
index.alt.026: Isibonelo sokugqama kwekhasi lokufunda ngaphambi nangemva kokulungiswa
index.text.028: Kwenza umbhalo oyinhloko nowesibili ofiphele ube mnyama ukuze ufundeke.
index.alt.029: Isibonelo semininingwane yezithunzi endaweni yemvelo ngaphambi nangemva kokulungiswa
index.text.031: Kukhanyisa amathoni amnyama ezithombe namavidiyo ukuze kuveze imininingwane yezithunzi.
index.alt.032: Isibonelo sezitshalo ezihleliwe ku-e-ink enemibala ngaphambi nangemva kokulungiswa
index.text.034: Nxephezela imibala efiphele ngoKugcwala Kombala ne-RGB.
index.text.035: Ukubuka kuqala okuyizibonelo. Imiphumela iyahlukahluka ngephaneli nangokuqukethwe kokuqala.
index.text.040: Uhlelo lusebenzisa izilawuli zomphakathi zesibonisi ezitholakala kusistimu ngayinye yokusebenza. Izilawuli ezingasekelwa ziyafihlwa noma zichazwe.
index.text.042: Ukugqama Kombhalo, Ukuthuthukisa Ividiyo, amajika, okusethiwe nezilungiselelo zesibonisi ngasinye.
index.text.044: Nciphisa Ukuthuthumela nokuphatha i-Night Shift / True Tone esibonisini ngasinye.
index.text.046: Amasistimu afanele e-Windows 10 2004 ne-Windows 11 21H2+; ukutholakala kuncike kusistimu nakuhadiwe.
index.text.049: Ukugqama Kombhalo kunikeza amazinga amane amakhasi anokugqama okuphansi.
index.text.050: Kusebenzise uma ufunda; kuhlukile ekuThuthukiseni Ividiyo.
index.text.053: Ukuthuthukisa Ividiyo kukhanyisa imininingwane yezithunzi ezithombeni nakumavidiyo.
index.text.054: Kuvale uma ufunda ngoba kukhanyisa nombhalo omnyama.
index.text.057: Sebenzisa okusethiwe noma izilawuli eziqondile ukuze unxephezele uhla lwemibala olulinganiselwe.
index.text.058: Ukutholakala kuncike kusistimu yokusebenza, ku-GPU, kumshayeli nasendleleni yokuxhumeka kwesibonisi.
index.text.061: Maka kuphela izibonisi ze-e-ink ofuna uhlelo luzishintshe.
index.text.062: Londoloza amajika ezibonisi ezihlukene, bese ubuyisela izilungiselelo zokuqala uma uphuma ohlelweni.
index.alt.063: Izilawuli ezithuthukile ze-E-Ink Assistant zejika lethoni ngesiNgisi
index.text.066: Shintsha iphuzu lokugoba, i-gamma, iphuzu elimnyama nephuzu elimhlophe ubuka ijika.
index.text.067: Londoloza okusethiwe okuqanjwe amagama okufika kokuhlanu. Izilungiselelo zigcinwa ngokwehlukana ngesibonisi ngasinye.
index.text.082: Amazinga amane: Okumaphakathi, Okuqinile, Okubukhali, Okuminyene
index.text.085: Isihleli sejika esibonisa izinguquko ngaso leso sikhathi nokusethiwe okuhlanu okuqanjwe amagama
index.text.087: Iphrofayela yombala yesibonisi ngasinye; ukugcwala kombala 0%–300% ne-RGB 0%–200%
index.text.088: Kutholakala kumasistimu afanele e-Windows 10 2004 ne-Windows 11 21H2+; indlela etholakalayo incike kusistimu nakuhadiwe
index.text.090: Kutholakala ezibonisini zangaphandle ezisekelwayo; kuyavuleka uma isibonisi simakwe njenge-e-ink
index.text.091: Akutholakali. I-Windows ayinaso isilawuli esisodwa somphakathi se-dithering sesibonisi ngasinye, futhi amasistimu amaningi e-Windows cishe awasidingi.
index.text.094: Kutholakala kusukela ku-Windows 7 SP1 ngama-API esistimu ahambisanayo
index.text.097: Imodi Ekhanyayo ye-Windows yeseshini kuphela ku-Windows 10 1903+
index.text.099: Ukukhipha isibonisi ngasinye ku-Night Shift ne-True Tone; kudinga imvume yomlawuli nokuxhuma futhi
index.text.100: Izilungiselelo Zokukhanya kwasebusuku kusukela ku-Windows 10 1703+; isilawuli esiqondile sokuvala Ukukhanya Kwasebusuku ku-Windows 11 24H2+
index.text.102: Izibonisi zangempela ezibonisa okufanayo zisengakhethwa ngokwehlukana
index.text.103: Amajika ethoni athinta umthombo owabelwana ngawo; Ukugcwala Kombala ne-RGB kudinga imodi ethi Nweba
index.text.105: Amajika esikhashana, amaphrofayela ombala ne-dithering kubuyiselwa esimweni sokuqala uma uphuma; ukukhipha ku-Night Shift / True Tone kuhlala kunjalo
index.text.106: Izinguquko zesikhashana ze-gamma, umbala, ukubukeka Nokukhanya kwasebusuku zibuyiselwa uma uphuma; umbala Nokukhanya kwasebusuku kubuyiselwa nangemva kokuphuma okungajwayelekile
index.text.109: Izilimi zesixhumi esibonakalayo ezintweni ezilandekayo zamanje
index.text.110: IsiNgisi, isiShayina Esenziwe Lula, isiShayina Sendabuko, isiJapane
index.text.112: Kuphela uma ukhetha ukukhipha ku-Night Shift / True Tone
index.text.116: Zombili izinhlobo zimahhala futhi zinekhodi evulekile.
index.text.117: macOS 2.6↓Windows 1.2↓
index.text.118: macOS 14+ Apple silicon · Windows 7 SP1–11 x64
index.text.123: Zama ukuvula uhlelo kanye. Uma i-macOS iluvimba, vula Izilungiselelo Zesistimu → Ubumfihlo & Ukuphepha bese ukhetha Vula Noma Kunjalo.
index.text.124: Le softhiwe ithuthukiswe ngokuzimela futhi okwamanje ayikho ku-App Store. I-macOS izobonisa isexwayiso esithi “ayikwazi ukuqinisekisa” uma uyivula okokuqala. Ikhodi ivulekile ngokuphelele, ngakho ungayihlola ngaphambi kokunquma ukuthi uyayisebenzisa yini.
index.text.126: Ngemva kokuhambisa uhlelo ku-Izinhlelo Zokusebenza, vula i-Terminal bese usebenzisa:
index.text.128: Landa i-macOS 2.6 ↓Uma ikusiza, nikeza iphrojekthi inkanyezi ku-GitHub ↗
index.text.133: Vula i-E‑Ink Assistant kumenyu ethi Qala noma kuthreyi yesistimu.
index.text.134: Nge-Windows 7 SP1 kuya ku-Windows 11 kumakhompyutha e-x64. Izilawuli ezitholakalayo zincike enguqulweni ye-Windows, ku-GPU, kumshayeli nasekuxhumekeni kwesibonisi.
index.text.135: Landa i-Windows 1.2 ↓Uma ikusiza, nikeza iphrojekthi inkanyezi ku-GitHub ↗
changelog.description.138: Umlando wokukhishwa kwezinhlobo ze-macOS ne-Windows ze-E-Ink Assistant.
changelog.text.146: Izibonisi zesibili ezibonisa okufanayo ngehadiwe zisengakhethwa ngokwehlukana futhi zilungiswa ngokuxhumeka kwangempela.
changelog.text.147: Ukushintsha phakathi kokubonisa okufanayo nokunweba kuvuselela ngokushesha izilungiselelo zesibonisi bese kuzisebenzisa futhi.
changelog.text.148: Ukusebenzisa futhi nokubuyisela esimweni sokuqala uma uphuma kuthinta kuphela amaphaneli e-e-ink amakiwe, kuhlanganise nezibonisi ezixhunyiwe ezibonisa okufanayo.
changelog.text.149: Icebiso lokusetha manje liqondisa ngokucacile abasebenzisi kumenyu yesibonisi uqobo.
changelog.text.152: Isikhumbuzo esingavalwa manje sivela ngaphezu kwezilawuli, sinesibonelo se-Bigme B251 Pro.
changelog.text.153: Ngiyaqonda kufihla isikhumbuzo kule seshini; Ungaphindi ukubonise kugcinwa nangemva kokuqalisa futhi.
changelog.text.154: Iphaneli yokwamukela manje isebenzisa amaphuzu amathathu amafushane okusetha anezithonjana.
changelog.text.155: Izibonisi ezakhelwe ngaphakathi manje zivela ngemva kwezangaphandle ohlwini lokukhetha.
changelog.text.159: Iphaneli yokulawula manje isebenzisa ukuphakama okubonakalayo kwesikrini esinento yebha yemenyu.
changelog.text.160: Okuqukethwe okude kuyaskrolwa futhi kushiya amaphoyinti angu-40 ngaphezu kwe-Dock noma onqenqemeni lwesikrini. Amaphaneli amafushane agcina ukuphakama kwawo kwemvelo.
changelog.text.163: Okumaphakathi kusebenzisa ijika Okuqinile langaphambili. Okuqinile, Okubukhali nokuthi Okuminyene kuya ngokuya kuba mnyama.
changelog.text.164: Okubukhali kusebenzisa i-gamma 5.00 nephuzu elimnyama 0.10. Okuminyene kusebenzisa i-gamma 6.00 nephuzu elimnyama 0.34. Kokubili kususa imininingwane empunga eminingi futhi kwenza imiphetho ibe lukhuni.
changelog.text.167: Kulungiswe ukushintsha ulimi engxenyeni ethi Kusebenza kanjani.
changelog.text.168: Isihloko sengxenye nenkinobho ethi Bonisa okwengeziwe / Bonisa okuncane manje kuyabuyekezwa ngokushesha uma kushintsha ulimi lohlelo.
changelog.text.171: Umsizi angasebenza lapho i-Mac ikhiyiwe, uvimbele izexwayiso ze-Shortcuts ngesikhathi sokunqamula nokubuyisela izilungiselelo.
changelog.text.172: Abasebenzisi abathuthukisa besuka ku-v2.0 kufanele bengeze umsizi oqanjwe kabusha kanye, bese bengasusa umsizi omdala.
changelog.text.175: Kwengezwe izilawuli zesibonisi, izilimi nesifaki se-DMG.
changelog.text.176: Kwengezwe izilawuli ze-RGB, Night Shift ne-True Tone zesibonisi ngasinye.
changelog.text.177: Kwengezwe isilawuli esithi Nciphisa Ukubonakala Ngale Nokunyakaza ngomsizi we-Shortcuts oqinisekiswa umsebenzisi.
changelog.text.178: Kwengezwe isiNgisi, isiShayina Esenziwe Lula, isiShayina Sendabuko nesiJapane.
changelog.text.180: Kwengezwe ukulawula i-Night Shift ne-True Tone kwesibonisi ngasinye.
changelog.text.181: Ushintsho ludinga iphasiwedi yomlawuli nokuxhuma isibonisi futhi. Aluhlehliswa uma uphuma ohlelweni.
changelog.text.184: Kwengezwe Nciphisa Ukuthuthumela, Ukugcwala Kombala, Ukugqama Kombhalo, Ukuthuthukisa Ividiyo, amajika ethoni enziwe ngokwezifiso, izindawo zamajika alondoloziwe nokubuyisela izibonisi uma uphuma.
changelog.text.187: Kuthuthukiswe ukubuyiselwa kwezilawuli zombala esimweni sokuqala.
changelog.text.188: Kulungiswe izexwayiso zamanga zokwehluleka kwesici lapho i-Windows inikeza indlela yokucubungula umbala kodwa ingavumeli uhlelo ukuthi lushintshe isimo sayo.
changelog.text.189: Idatha yokubuyisela iyagcinwa ngesikhathi imodi Yokuphindaphinda ivala ukulawula umbala okwesikhashana, bese izilungiselelo zibuyiselwa lapho kubuya ukuhlelwa kwezibonisi okungalawuleka.
changelog.text.191: Kwengezwe Ukugqama Kombhalo, Ukuthuthukisa Ividiyo, amajika athuthukile, okusethiwe nokukhetha izibonisi ze-e-ink ngesibonisi ngasinye.
changelog.text.192: Kwengezwe izilawuli ezihambisanayo Zokugcwala Kombala, RGB, Imodi Ekhanyayo ye-Windows Nokukhanya kwasebusuku, ezinokubuyisela izilungiselelo nokululama ngemva kokuphahlazeka.
changelog.text.193: Kwengezwe ukuphathwa kwezibonisi eziphindaphindwayo, isingeniso sethreyi yesistimu, ukuqala lapho ungena, izibuyekezo nesifaki sezilimi eziningi.
